generic.Defined scope/population: Current/deferred provision workpaper, BTD schedule, DTA/DTL rollforward and rate reconciliation
generic.In-scope period: The tax provision period just closed and reviewed by the Controller
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Tax period, legal entity and preparer/reviewer initials tagged on every file
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived file count matches the four required workpaper components
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived files match the Controller-signed version with upload timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing or untagged files logged in the exceptions tracker with an owner
generic.Test population: All provision workpapers required for the current close period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass only when all four workpaper components are archived and tagged
generic.Exception handling path: Missing files escalate to Tax Manager before close sign-off is granted
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive package ties exactly to the version the Controller signed off
generic.Evidence location: Tax SharePoint library, current fiscal-year folder structure

steps.title: Collect the provision workpaper set from SAP S/4HANA and the provision model
sop: Pull the current/deferred provision workpaper, BTD schedule, DTA/DTL rollforward and rate reconciliation.
Confirm each file reflects the final Controller-reviewed version.
Done when all four workpaper components are collected in one folder.
verify: Count the collected files against the provision index checklist.
Pass when all four components are present and match the final version.

steps.title: Tag each file with tax period, legal entity and preparer/reviewer initials
sop: Rename or label each file with tax period, legal entity code and preparer/reviewer initials.
Spot-check tags against the provision index for consistency.
Done when every file carries all three tag elements.
verify: Open a sample of tagged files and confirm the naming convention.
Pass when no file is missing a tag element.

steps.title: Upload the tagged package to the tax SharePoint library
sop: Open the current fiscal-year folder in the tax SharePoint library.
Upload the tagged workpaper set into the correct subfolder.
Done when the full package is visible in SharePoint.
verify: Browse to the SharePoint folder and confirm the upload.
Pass when the file count in SharePoint matches the collected set.

steps.title: Confirm the archive matches the Controller-signed provision version
sop: Compare the archived workpaper set to the version the Controller signed off.
Flag any file that differs from the signed version.
Done when the archive is confirmed identical to the signed package.
verify: Cross-check last-modified dates against the sign-off record.
Pass when every archived file matches the signed version.

steps.title: Record the archive location in the tax provision index
sop: Open the tax provision index tracker.
Enter the SharePoint folder path and archive date for the period.
Done when the index row is updated with the location reference.
verify: Reopen the index and confirm the link resolves to the folder.
Pass when the recorded link opens the correct archive.

steps.title: Log any missing or untagged files as exceptions
sop: Review the archive against the four-item checklist.
Log each gap in the exceptions tracker with an owner and target date.
Done when every gap has a logged disposition.
verify: Review the exceptions tracker for items without an owner.
Pass when no exception lacks an owner and date.

steps.title: Obtain Tax Manager confirmation the archive is complete
sop: Review the completed archive package and index entry.
Confirm no open exceptions remain unresolved.
Done when Tax Manager confirms completeness in writing.
verify: Check for the Tax Manager's written confirmation in SharePoint.
Pass when confirmation is on file with no open exceptions.

generic.Defined scope/population: DTA categories by legal entity: NOL, AMT credit and capital loss carryforwards
generic.In-scope period: Current provision period's realizability assessment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Three-year cumulative loss test result and future taxable income projection per entity
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Valuation allowance total ties to the sum of DTA category adjustments
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: DTA realizability memo version stamped and stored with Tax Director sign-off date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entities failing the cumulative loss test logged with the allowance conclusion
generic.Test population: Every legal entity carrying a DTA balance subject to realizability testing
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every DTA category has a documented realizability conclusion
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved realizability judgment calls escalate to Tax Director for concurrence
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Valuation allowance amount is set only after Tax Director concurrence is obtained
generic.Evidence location: DTA realizability memo filed in the tax provision workpaper library

steps.title: Update the DTA realizability memo in the provision workpaper
sop: Open the DTA realizability memo template in the provision workpaper.
Run the three-year cumulative loss test and update future taxable income projections.
Done when the memo reflects current-period loss history and projections.
verify: Compare the projection inputs to the latest approved forecast.
Pass when the memo ties to the current forecast without stale figures.

steps.title: Assess NOL and capital loss carryforward expiration risk
sop: List each carryforward by entity with its expiration year.
Compare projected future taxable income to the carryforward balance and expiration schedule.
Done when each carryforward is flagged as likely-to-expire or likely-to-be-used.
verify: Recompute one entity's expiration schedule independently.
Pass when the recomputation matches the memo's conclusion.

steps.title: Document tax-planning strategies considered as a source of income
sop: List any tax-planning strategy (e.g. asset sale, election change) evaluated as an income source.
Note whether each strategy is prudent and feasible under current facts.
Done when the memo documents every strategy considered, even if rejected.
verify: Confirm each listed strategy has a feasibility conclusion.
Pass when no considered strategy is left without a conclusion.

steps.title: Set or adjust the valuation allowance by DTA category
sop: Compute the recommended valuation allowance for NOL, AMT credit and capital loss DTAs.
Enter the allowance amounts in the provision workpaper's allowance schedule.
Done when every DTA category has a proposed allowance amount.
verify: Foot the allowance schedule to the total valuation allowance.
Pass when the schedule total agrees with the provision entry.

steps.title: Route the valuation allowance conclusion to the Tax Director
sop: Package the memo, carryforward schedule and proposed allowance for review.
Send the package to the Tax Director with a summary of judgment areas.
Done when the package is routed and receipt is confirmed.
verify: Confirm the Tax Director opened the routed package.
Pass when routing confirmation is logged in SharePoint.

steps.title: Obtain Tax Director concurrence on the valuation allowance
sop: Review the realizability memo, carryforward analysis and proposed allowance.
Record concurrence or requested changes on the memo.
Done when the Tax Director's concurrence is documented on the memo.
verify: Confirm the memo carries a dated Tax Director signature or approval note.
Pass when concurrence is documented before the provision is finalized.

generic.Defined scope/population: Taxable income by legal entity subject to current federal/state statutory rates
generic.In-scope period: Current tax provision period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Statutory rate, estimated payments made and prior-year overpayment applied forward
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Computed current liability ties to the GL current tax payable account
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rate table version and computation date recorded on the liability workpaper
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Jurisdictions with mid-period rate changes flagged with the applied rate noted
generic.Test population: Every legal entity with taxable income in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the computed liability reconciles to GL within a zero-tolerance threshold
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled variances route to Tax Manager before the provision rollforward
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Liability is accepted only once tied to the GL current tax payable balance
generic.Evidence location: Provision workpaper, current tax liability tab

steps.title: Apply the current statutory rate to taxable income by entity in the provision model
sop: Pull taxable income by legal entity from the provision workpaper input tab.
Apply the current federal and state statutory rate to each entity's taxable income.
Done when every entity shows a computed current tax amount.
verify: Recompute one entity's tax by hand against the applied rate.
Pass when the recomputation matches the model output.

steps.title: Incorporate estimated payments and prior-year overpayment in SAP S/4HANA
sop: Pull estimated payments made and prior-year overpayment applied forward from SAP S/4HANA.
Net these amounts against the gross computed liability per entity.
Done when the net current liability reflects payments and carryforward credits.
verify: Trace the payment amounts to the GL payment postings.
Pass when payment figures match the GL without variance.

steps.title: Reconcile the computed liability to the GL current tax payable account
sop: Pull the GL current tax payable balance from SAP S/4HANA.
Compare the computed liability to the GL balance by entity.
Done when every entity's computed liability ties to its GL balance.
verify: Recheck any entity showing a variance for a posting or timing error.
Pass when the total variance across entities is zero.

steps.title: Flag jurisdictions with rate changes effective in the current period
sop: Compare the applied rate table to the prior period's rate table.
Flag any jurisdiction with a rate change and note the effective date.
Done when all rate changes for the period are flagged in the workpaper.
verify: Confirm each flagged rate change matches the legislative tracking log.
Pass when no rate change is missing a flag.

steps.title: Route the computed liability to the provision rollforward
sop: Copy the finalized current liability by entity into the rollforward schedule.
Confirm the rollforward picks up the correct period column.
Done when the rollforward reflects the current-period liability.
verify: Cross-check the rollforward entry against the liability workpaper.
Pass when the two figures match exactly.

steps.title: Obtain Tax Manager review of the current liability computation
sop: Review the liability workpaper, GL reconciliation and flagged rate changes.
Confirm no open reconciling item remains.
Done when Tax Manager signs off on the current liability computation.
verify: Confirm the sign-off is recorded on the workpaper.
Pass when sign-off is dated and no open items remain.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current and deferred tax provision (ASC 740) for every consolidated legal entity
generic.In-scope period: Current quarter or annual provision period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Beginning balance, current-period activity and ending balance for each DTA/DTL
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total tax expense reconciles to book pre-tax income times blended rate
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Provision model version and Tax Director review date stamped on the file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unexplained rate-to-provision deltas logged with a research note
generic.Test population: Every DTA/DTL rollforward line item and the current tax computation by entity
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the rollforward ties to the trial balance with zero unexplained variance
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled deltas route to Tax Director before the model is posted
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Provision is finalized only after Tax Director review of the completed model
generic.Evidence location: Oracle EPM provision model, current-period workspace

steps.title: Compute the current tax provision by legal entity in Oracle EPM
sop: Load taxable income by entity into the Oracle EPM provision model.
Multiply by the applicable statutory rate to derive the current provision.
Done when every entity shows a computed current provision.
verify: Spot-check one entity's current provision against the rate table.
Pass when the spot check matches the model output.

steps.title: Compute the deferred provision from DTA/DTL balance changes
sop: Pull beginning and ending DTA/DTL balances by item from Oracle EPM.
Compute the deferred provision as the net period-over-period change.
Done when the deferred provision is computed for every DTA/DTL item.
verify: Recompute one item's deferred provision independently.
Pass when the recomputation matches the model.

steps.title: Build the DTA/DTL rollforward schedule in the provision model
sop: Populate beginning balance, current-period activity and ending balance for each item.
Confirm the ending balance rolls forward to next period's beginning balance.
Done when the rollforward is complete for every DTA/DTL item.
verify: Foot the rollforward columns for each item.
Pass when beginning plus activity equals ending for every row.

steps.title: Reconcile total tax expense to book pre-tax income times blended rate
sop: Pull consolidated book pre-tax income from SAP S/4HANA.
Compute the expected expense at the blended rate and compare to total provision.
Done when the delta is explained by identified reconciling items.
verify: Confirm each reconciling item ties to the rate reconciliation workpaper.
Pass when the residual unexplained delta is zero.

steps.title: Reconcile the rollforward to the trial balance
sop: Pull the trial balance DTA/DTL and tax payable balances from SAP S/4HANA.
Compare to the provision model's ending balances.
Done when every balance ties to the trial balance.
verify: Investigate any entity showing a variance to the trial balance.
Pass when all entities tie with zero unexplained variance.

steps.title: Route the completed provision model for Tax Director review
sop: Package the current/deferred computation, rollforward and rate reconciliation.
Send the package to the Tax Director before the posting deadline.
Done when the package is routed and receipt is confirmed.
verify: Confirm the Tax Director opened the routed package.
Pass when routing is confirmed ahead of the posting deadline.

steps.title: Obtain Tax Director review approval before posting
sop: Review the current/deferred computation and rollforward reconciliation.
Approve or return the model with requested changes.
Done when the model carries a dated Tax Director approval.
verify: Confirm the approval is documented in Oracle EPM or SharePoint.
Pass when approval is recorded before the entries are posted.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every reconciling item bridging statutory rate to effective tax rate
generic.In-scope period: Current quarter's effective tax rate reconciliation
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Permanent versus timing classification for each reconciling item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of reconciling items plus statutory rate equals the effective tax rate
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rate reconciliation workpaper version dated with Controller review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items exceeding $100K or 50bps variance logged with an explanation
generic.Test population: All reconciling items identified for the current quarter
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every item over $100K is quantified and variances over 50bps explained
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained variance over 50bps routes to Controller before the reconciliation is finalized
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation is complete only when every item is classified and quantified
generic.Evidence location: Rate reconciliation workpaper in the provision file

steps.title: Build the rate reconciliation bridge in the provision workpaper
sop: List the statutory rate as the starting line of the reconciliation.
Add each reconciling item line by line down to the effective tax rate.
Done when the bridge ties from statutory rate to effective rate.
verify: Foot the bridge from statutory rate through all reconciling items.
Pass when the sum equals the computed effective tax rate.

steps.title: Classify each reconciling item as permanent or timing
sop: Review each item (e.g. tax-exempt muni interest, DRD) against ASC 740 guidance.
Tag each item as permanent or timing in the workpaper.
Done when every reconciling item carries a classification tag.
verify: Spot-check three classifications against the underlying book-to-tax schedule.
Pass when all spot-checked classifications are correct.

steps.title: Quantify the rate impact in basis points for items over $100K
sop: Identify reconciling items with a dollar impact over $100K.
Convert each to a basis-point impact on the effective tax rate.
Done when every over-$100K item shows a basis-point figure.
verify: Recompute one item's basis-point conversion.
Pass when the recomputation matches the workpaper.

steps.title: Compare current-quarter ETR to the prior forecast
sop: Pull the prior forecasted effective tax rate from the last provision cycle.
Compare to the current-quarter computed ETR and note the variance.
Done when variances over 50bps carry a documented explanation.
verify: Confirm each over-50bps variance has a written explanation.
Pass when no over-50bps variance is left unexplained.

steps.title: Route the completed reconciliation to the Controller for review
sop: Package the rate reconciliation and variance explanations.
Send the package to the Controller ahead of the close deadline.
Done when the package is routed and receipt is confirmed.
verify: Confirm the Controller opened the routed package.
Pass when routing is confirmed before the close deadline.

steps.title: Obtain Controller review approval of the rate reconciliation
sop: Review the rate bridge, classifications and variance explanations.
Approve or return the reconciliation with requested changes.
Done when the reconciliation carries a dated Controller approval.
verify: Confirm the approval is documented on the workpaper.
Pass when approval is recorded before the footnote draft begins.

generic.Defined scope/population: Components-of-expense, rate reconciliation, DTA/DTL and UTP disclosure tables
generic.In-scope period: Current reporting period's income tax footnote
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every dollar figure ties to the underlying provision workpaper
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Footnote table totals match the provision workpaper totals line for line
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft footnote version dated and stored in the provision file
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Untied figures logged and corrected before the draft is routed for review
generic.Test population: Every required ASC 740 disclosure table in the footnote draft
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when all tables are drafted and every figure ties without exception
generic.Exception handling path: Untied figures escalate to Tax Director before Controller review
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Footnote is complete only when all tables tie to the provision workpaper
generic.Evidence location: BlackLine close task attachment for the footnote disclosure

steps.title: Draft the components-of-income-tax-expense table in the footnote template
sop: Pull current/deferred, federal/state expense figures from the provision workpaper.
Populate the components-of-expense table in the footnote template.
Done when the table reflects the final provision figures.
verify: Foot the table components to the total tax expense.
Pass when the table total matches the provision total.

steps.title: Draft the rate reconciliation table matching the workpaper
sop: Copy each reconciling item from the rate reconciliation workpaper.
Format the items into the footnote's rate reconciliation table.
Done when the table matches the workpaper line for line.
verify: Compare the table total to the workpaper's effective tax rate.
Pass when the totals agree exactly.

steps.title: Draft the DTA/DTL components table and allowance rollforward narrative
sop: Pull DTA/DTL balances by category from the provision workpaper.
Draft the valuation allowance rollforward narrative from the DTA memo.
Done when the table and narrative are complete.
verify: Tie the table totals to the DTA/DTL inventory schedule.
Pass when totals match without variance.

steps.title: Draft the uncertain tax position rollforward narrative if applicable
sop: Pull the FIN 48 rollforward schedule for the period.
Draft the narrative describing additions, releases and settlements.
Done when the narrative reflects the current UTP rollforward.
verify: Confirm the narrative figures match the UTP rollforward schedule.
Pass when figures match with no discrepancy.

steps.title: Tie every dollar figure in the draft footnote to the provision workpaper
sop: Walk each footnote figure back to its source line in the provision workpaper.
Correct any figure that does not tie.
Done when every figure is confirmed tied to source.
verify: Re-trace a sample of five figures to the workpaper.
Pass when all five trace without exception.

steps.title: Route the footnote draft to Tax Director and Controller for review
sop: Attach the completed draft to the BlackLine close task.
Notify the Tax Director and Controller for review.
Done when the draft is attached and reviewers are notified.
verify: Confirm both reviewers acknowledged receipt.
Pass when acknowledgment is logged before the disclosure deadline.

steps.title: Obtain Tax Director sign-off on the completed footnote draft
sop: Review each table and narrative against the provision workpaper.
Approve or return the draft with requested edits.
Done when the draft carries a dated Tax Director approval.
verify: Confirm the approval is recorded on the BlackLine close task.
Pass when approval is logged before external reporting.

generic.Defined scope/population: Temporary differences from NOL/capital loss carryforwards, reserve discounting and DAC
generic.In-scope period: Current provision period's DTA/DTL identification
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Temporary versus permanent classification for every identified item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tax-effected balances sum to the DTA/DTL inventory schedule total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: DTA/DTL inventory schedule version dated with current-period update
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Permanent items mistakenly included are removed and logged as corrected
generic.Test population: Every book-to-tax difference identified for the current period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when all differences are classified, tax-effected and no permanent item remains
generic.Exception handling path: Misclassified items route to Controller for correction before provision use
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Inventory is accepted only when every item is classified and tax-effected
generic.Evidence location: DTA/DTL inventory schedule in Oracle EPM

steps.title: Identify DTAs from carryforwards and reserve discounting in Oracle EPM
sop: Pull NOL/capital loss carryforward balances and reserve discount schedules.
List each as a candidate DTA in the inventory schedule.
Done when all candidate DTAs are listed with source references.
verify: Confirm each candidate ties to its source schedule.
Pass when every DTA candidate has a traceable source.

steps.title: Identify DTLs from DAC capitalization and amortization differences
sop: Pull DAC capitalization and amortization schedules from SAP S/4HANA.
List each basis difference as a candidate DTL in the inventory schedule.
Done when all candidate DTLs are listed with source references.
verify: Confirm each candidate ties to its source schedule.
Pass when every DTL candidate has a traceable source.

steps.title: Classify each item as temporary versus permanent
sop: Review each identified item against ASC 740 temporary-difference criteria.
Remove any item that is actually permanent from the DTA/DTL list.
Done when only temporary differences remain in the inventory.
verify: Spot-check three items for correct temporary classification.
Pass when no permanent item remains in the inventory.

steps.title: Compute the tax-effected balance for each DTA/DTL in Oracle EPM
sop: Apply the current statutory rate to each identified item's balance.
Record the tax-effected amount in the inventory schedule.
Done when every item shows a tax-effected balance.
verify: Recompute one item's tax-effected balance by hand.
Pass when the recomputation matches the schedule.

steps.title: Update the DTA/DTL inventory schedule with current-period items
sop: Add the current-period identified items to the inventory schedule.
Remove any item that reversed or is no longer applicable.
Done when the inventory reflects only current, active items.
verify: Foot the schedule to confirm the total ties to the provision.
Pass when the inventory total agrees with the provision entry.

steps.title: Obtain Controller review of the updated DTA/DTL inventory
sop: Review the classification and tax-effected balances in the inventory.
Approve or flag items for further research.
Done when the Controller confirms the inventory is accurate.
verify: Confirm the review sign-off is recorded on the schedule.
Pass when sign-off is dated with no open flags.

generic.Defined scope/population: Provision summary, rate reconciliation, DTA/DTL rollforward and footnote draft package
generic.In-scope period: Current tax provision close period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every package component reflects the final reviewed provision figures
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sign-off package totals match the posted provision journal entries
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Controller approval captured in the BlackLine close task with a timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controller-requested changes logged and confirmed incorporated before final sign-off
generic.Test population: The complete sign-off package for the current provision period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when sign-off is captured with zero open review comments
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved comments escalate to CFO if provision exceeds the materiality trigger
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off is valid only when captured via the BlackLine close task approval
generic.Evidence location: BlackLine close task approval record for the provision period

steps.title: Assemble the sign-off package in BlackLine
sop: Gather the provision summary, rate reconciliation, DTA/DTL rollforward and footnote draft.
Attach the package to the BlackLine close task for the period.
Done when all four components are attached to the close task.
verify: Open the close task and confirm all attachments are present.
Pass when the package is complete with no missing component.

steps.title: Walk the Controller through current-quarter true-ups and unusual items
sop: Schedule a review walkthrough with the Controller.
Explain each true-up and unusual reconciling item in the package.
Done when the walkthrough covers every true-up and unusual item.
verify: Confirm the Controller's questions from the walkthrough are logged.
Pass when all raised questions have a documented answer.

steps.title: Capture the Controller's sign-off via the BlackLine close task approval
sop: Review the assembled package and walkthrough notes.
Apply the approval action on the BlackLine close task, not by email.
Done when the close task shows a Controller approval.
verify: Confirm the approval is recorded natively in BlackLine.
Pass when no approval exists only in email or chat.

steps.title: Log and confirm any Controller-requested changes are incorporated
sop: Log each change the Controller requested during review.
Update the package and confirm each change is reflected.
Done when every requested change is incorporated and logged.
verify: Compare the updated package to the logged request list.
Pass when every requested change is confirmed applied.

steps.title: Confirm the CFO review threshold and escalate if exceeded
sop: Compare the total provision amount to the CFO materiality trigger.
Escalate to CFO review if the trigger is exceeded.
Done when the threshold check and any escalation are documented.
verify: Confirm the threshold comparison is recorded on the package.
Pass when escalation occurred if and only if the trigger was met.

steps.title: Confirm final sign-off with no open review comments
sop: Reconfirm all requested changes are incorporated.
Finalize the BlackLine close task approval status.
Done when the close task shows final approval with zero open items.
verify: Reopen the close task to confirm no open comments remain.
Pass when the task status shows fully approved.

generic.Defined scope/population: Pre-tax income by legal entity and jurisdiction from financial reporting
generic.In-scope period: Current close period's income statement by entity
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pre-tax income figures tie to the trial balance income statement by entity
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of entity-level pre-tax income ties to the consolidated total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loaded figures dated and versioned in the provision workpaper input tab
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entities with pre-tax losses flagged for valuation-allowance scoping
generic.Test population: Every legal entity and jurisdiction in the consolidation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when all entity figures tie to trial balance with zero variance
generic.Exception handling path: Untied figures route back to the financial reporting team for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Figures are accepted only once confirmed against the trial balance
generic.Evidence location: Provision workpaper input tab, current-period column

steps.title: Request pre-tax income by entity from the financial reporting team
sop: Send the data request per the close calendar to financial reporting.
Specify legal entity and jurisdiction breakdown required.
Done when the request is sent with the required breakdown specified.
verify: Confirm the request was sent before the close-calendar deadline.
Pass when the request specifies every required entity and jurisdiction.

steps.title: Confirm figures agree to the trial balance income statement
sop: Pull the trial balance income statement by entity from SAP S/4HANA.
Compare received figures line by line to the trial balance.
Done when every entity's figure is confirmed tied to trial balance.
verify: Spot-check three entities against the trial balance independently.
Pass when all spot-checked entities match exactly.

steps.title: Confirm intercompany eliminations are reflected consistently
sop: Review the consolidation elimination entries for the period.
Confirm the received pre-tax income reflects the same eliminations.
Done when elimination treatment is confirmed consistent.
verify: Compare one elimination entry to the consolidation schedule.
Pass when treatment matches without discrepancy.

steps.title: Flag entities with pre-tax losses for valuation-allowance scoping
sop: Identify entities showing a pre-tax loss for the period.
Flag each for early NOL and valuation-allowance scoping.
Done when every loss entity is flagged in the workpaper.
verify: Cross-check flagged entities against the loss list from the trial balance.
Pass when every loss entity is flagged.

steps.title: Load confirmed figures into the provision workpaper input tab
sop: Enter the confirmed pre-tax income by entity into the input tab.
Confirm the input tab totals match the confirmed figures.
Done when the input tab is fully populated for the period.
verify: Foot the input tab against the confirmed figure list.
Pass when the totals agree exactly.

steps.title: Confirm the loaded data set is ready for provision computation
sop: Review the input tab for completeness across all entities.
Confirm no entity is missing a pre-tax income figure.
Done when the input tab is confirmed complete.
verify: Recheck the entity count against the consolidation entity list.
Pass when every consolidated entity has a loaded figure.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current tax payable, DTA, DTL and income tax expense GL accounts
generic.In-scope period: Current close period after provision entries are posted
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each reconciling item has a threshold comparison and disposition
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: GL account balances tie to the provision workpaper supporting balances
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation attachment stored in BlackLine with a completion timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unresolved items rolled to the aged-items tracker with owner and target date
generic.Test population: Every tax-related GL account posted to during the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when no reconciling item remains open past the close deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Items over threshold route for investigation before close sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation completes only when BlackLine shows a supporting attachment
generic.Evidence location: BlackLine reconciliation task for the tax GL accounts

steps.title: Reconcile current tax payable, DTA and DTL accounts to the provision workpaper
sop: Pull GL balances for current tax payable, DTA and DTL from SAP S/4HANA.
Compare each balance to the corresponding provision workpaper figure.
Done when every account is compared against its workpaper figure.
verify: Recheck one account's GL balance against the workpaper independently.
Pass when the recheck matches without variance.

steps.title: Reconcile the income tax expense account to the P&L provision entry
sop: Pull the income tax expense GL balance from SAP S/4HANA.
Compare it to the posted P&L provision entry amount.
Done when the expense account ties to the provision entry.
verify: Confirm the posted journal entry amount matches the GL balance.
Pass when the two amounts agree exactly.

steps.title: Investigate and clear reconciling items over the account threshold
sop: Identify any reconciling item exceeding the account-specific threshold.
Research the root cause and clear or adjust as needed.
Done when every over-threshold item is cleared or explained.
verify: Confirm each cleared item has supporting documentation.
Pass when no over-threshold item remains unexplained.

steps.title: Confirm the reconciliation is completed in BlackLine with support
sop: Attach supporting schedules to the BlackLine reconciliation task.
Mark the reconciliation complete before the close deadline.
Done when BlackLine shows a completed status with attachments.
verify: Open BlackLine and confirm the attachment and completed status.
Pass when both are present before the close deadline.

steps.title: Roll unresolved items to the aged-items tracker
sop: Identify any item that could not be cleared before close.
Log it in the aged-items tracker with an owner and target date.
Done when every unresolved item has a tracker entry.
